# openwrt_system_ntp (Resource)

Manages OpenWrt NTP (timeserver) configuration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Instance name (e.g., 'ntp').

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable NTP client.
- `port` (Number) NTP port (default: 123).
- `server` (List of String) NTP servers (e.g., ['0.openwrt.pool.ntp.org', '1.openwrt.pool.ntp.org']).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID: system/ntp.
